scope: Accounting-method audit of archived SPY long/cash Donchian55/20; no original Turtle verdict, optimization, unseen OOS or market-data fetch

source_fit.input: Frozen original SPY nominal daily OHLC and actual Yahoo cash dividend events
source_fit.signal: strict previous-close breakout of preceding55 highs/20 lows, next open, 0/1 long/cash
source_fit.cost: 5bps per side; dividend sale-fee switch is a diagnostic of Claude method, not proposed broker practice
source_fit.dividend_baseline: previous-close entitlement; credit before exdate open; hold cash at0% until next entry
source_fit.reinvestment_switch: if held after open, reinvest only current exdate credit at same close at zero cost
source_fit.realism: Neither instant exdate cash nor zero-fee close reinvestment certifies payment-date cash availability or broker DRIP execution; no fills/tax/FX assessed

known_claims.original_CSV_and_full_code: not_preserved per Claude; only prose received, claimed code/package not attached or found in Downloads

budget: 16 complete factorial accounting combinations per segment =48 diagnostic runs, plus hand-computed synthetic accounting checks. No per-dividend optimization or signal parameter alternatives.
interpretation: Can substantiate numerical reconstruction on frozen data and causal accounting explanation. Cannot prove lost historical inputs/code, fresh Yahoo identity or undisclosed package hashes. Stop on baseline mismatch; preserve all failures.
